findings.impact: Every otherwise-correct GPU02 parent row fails resource_contract_matched. The collector appends its generic resource disagreement, writes terminal_custody_with_binding_disagreements, and raises at the final error gate instead of producing its normal successful custody seal. This unnecessarily forces another independent resource reconciliation even after a successful GPU02 run.
findings.requested_correction: Require the new GPU02 job name in the current-job resource contract, preferably bound to the same reviewed job identity as the sbatch generator. Keep the old job name and failed allocation immutable in predecessor-history validation. Do not weaken or bypass resource/no-requeue checks.
findings.title: Match the collector resource predicate to the GPU02 submission name
findings.trigger: Collect a correctly submitted ace_llm_scientific_campaign_gpu02 allocation produced by build_packet.py:673.
findings.validation_scope: A focused new artificial resource-contract case should cover the generated GPU02 name with exact requested/allocated fields and no-requeue evidence, and rejection of the predecessor name for the new job. No old suites, comparison runs or real GPU work are needed for this correction. Reviewer ran no tests.
